cards.source: REF 4.3 (scribd 915391789/2040-Deck-HC) recovers the name and full effect of New Face Who Dis, which REF 4.3 notes is the same archetype as SUBMERGED. Two clauses are not expressible: 'these voters cannot be placed into Volatile Areas' is a placement RESTRICTION the Effect union cannot state (REF 5.5), and 'every player' cannot be stated either because `gerrymander` is the one resource-shaped op in cards.ts with NO `target` field — unlike `voters`, `gain` and `lose`. The card as shipped therefore affects you only. See KNOWN-GAPS.md G5 and G8.
cards.name: New Face Who Dis
cards.text: Immediately gerrymanders 1 of your majority or non-majority voters, under the normal gerrymandering rules.

cards.source: REF 4.3 (scribd 915391789/2040-Deck-HC) recovers the name and effect of Red Blooded. The scaling ('Players receive any 2 resources for EACH of their discarded voters') needs a per-unit iteration op — see KNOWN-GAPS.md G4. The fixed pair is represented instead.
cards.name: Red Blooded
cards.text: Discard 2 of your own voters from the board, permanently. Every opponent then gains 2 resources of their choice from the Public Reserve.

cards.source: REF 4.3 (scribd 915391789/2040-Deck-HC) recovers the name and effect of Ain't No Cure For Love. The OR-branch ('Donate 1 of your voters to the player on your left') needs a DONATE op aimed at a seat-relative neighbour, and the 'if you are unable to do either, ignore this card' clause needs a conditional — see KNOWN-GAPS.md G1.
cards.name: Ain't No Cure For Love
cards.text: Discard 2 of your own voters from the board, permanently.

cards.name: Quietly, The Ceiling Moved
cards.text: Every opponent discards 2 Funds to the Public Reserve. You then gain 1 voter.

cards.name: The Second Reading
cards.text: Every opponent gains 1 resource of their choice. You then get 2 discounts on purchases this turn.

cards.name: Long Winter, Short Ledger
cards.text: Evict 2 voters from the board. Every opponent then gains 1 resource of their choice.

cards.name: An Honest Institution
cards.text: Discard every face-up Voter Card and deal three fresh ones. Then gain 1 resource of your choice.

cards.name: Filed Under: Weather
cards.text: Every opponent discards 1 resource of their choice to the Public Reserve. You gain 2 Media.
